title: Rooting, spillhacking og tinkering
label: Tinkering
shortDescription: Rootet mobilen for å hacke spill, med skins i Subway Surfers og ubegrenset penger i Hill Climb Racing. Jeg ga ikke opp før jeg fant en vei rundt det som var utfordringene mine, blant annet et skript på Ubuntu som loggførte tastetrykk.

en.title: Rooting, game hacking and tinkering
en.label: Tinkering
en.shortDescription: Rooted my phone to hack games, with skins in Subway Surfers and unlimited money in Hill Climb Racing. I never gave up until I found a way around whatever challenge I was facing, including a script on Ubuntu that logged keystrokes.
